Meta.title: FocusFlow — Deep focus, made effortless
Meta.description: FocusFlow is the mobile app that helps you block distractions, build focus habits and finish what matters. Start free today.

Hero.subtitle: FocusFlow silences the noise, plans your deep-work sessions and turns focus into a daily habit — so you get more done in less time.

Features.title: Everything you need to stay in the zone
Features.subtitle: Powerful tools wrapped in a calm interface. No clutter, no guilt — just focus.

timer.title: Smart focus timer
timer.description: Adaptive Pomodoro-style sessions that learn your rhythm and suggest the ideal length for each task.

blocker.title: Distraction blocker
blocker.description: Silence noisy apps, notifications and sites during a session with a single tap.

planner.title: Daily planner
planner.description: Drag tasks into time blocks and let FocusFlow protect your calendar from overload.

insights.title: Insights & streaks
insights.description: Beautiful reports reveal when you focus best and keep you motivated with streaks.

sounds.title: Focus soundscapes
sounds.description: Rain, lo-fi, white noise and more — curated ambient audio that helps your brain lock in.

sync.title: Sync everywhere
sync.description: Your sessions, goals and stats stay in sync across iOS, Android and the web.

How.title: From scattered to focused in three steps
How.subtitle: Set it up once and let FocusFlow guide your day.

one.title: Set your goal
one.description: Pick a task, choose a session length and tell FocusFlow what a great day looks like.

two.title: Enter focus mode
two.description: Tap start. Distractions are blocked, the timer runs and the soundscape sets the mood.

three.title: Review & improve
three.description: See your progress, celebrate streaks and get smart tips to focus even better tomorrow.

About.title: Built by people who were tired of being distracted
About.paragraphOne: FocusFlow started in 2023 as a small side project between two friends — a designer and an engineer — who kept losing their afternoons to notifications.
About.paragraphTwo: Today a remote team of 24 builds a calmer way to work: tools that respect your attention, your time and your privacy.

calm.title: Calm by design
calm.description: Every pixel is there for a reason. Less noise, more clarity.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.description: Your focus data stays yours. We never sell it — ever.

science.title: Backed by science
science.description: Our methods are built on research in attention and deep work.

Pricing.title: Simple pricing that grows with you
Pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready. Cancel anytime.

free.name: Free
free.description: For getting started with better focus.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For professionals who need deep focus daily.

Testimonials.title: Loved by focused people everywhere
Testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from people who got their time back.

anna.quote: I finally finish my most important task before lunch. FocusFlow changed how I structure my entire day.
anna.name: Anna Kovalenko

marcus.quote: The distraction blocker alone is worth it. My team's deep-work time went up by a third in a month.
marcus.name: Marcus Lindgren

free.question: Is FocusFlow really free to start?
free.answer: Yes. The Free plan includes the smart focus timer and basic blocking forever. Upgrade only if you need more.

platforms.question: Which platforms are supported?
platforms.answer: FocusFlow works on iOS and Android, with a companion web dashboard for your stats and planner.

data.question: What happens to my data?
data.answer: Your focus data is encrypted and never sold. You can export or delete it at any time from settings.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Absolutely. Cancel in two taps from the app — you keep Pro until the end of your billing period.

teams.question: Do you offer discounts for teams or students?
teams.answer: Yes. Students get 50% off Pro, and Team plans include volume pricing. Reach out and we'll help.

Contact.title: Ready to find your flow?
Contact.subtitle: Join 250,000+ people focusing better with FocusFlow. Got a question? We usually reply within a day.
